{{Quote|Reverse course! Get the ship out of here now...''"<br />"''Captain, their scanners just locked on us... we're being targeted.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] and [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] of the ''Dauntless''-cruiser|<ref name="CE3.1" />}}
In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]] the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] vessel [[Endor (Dauntless-class)|''Endor'']] was '''ambushed''' by the [[Restored Empire]], an [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] faction of hardliners under the leadership of the [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Ennix Devian|Devian]] that refused the Imperial Remnant authority, while patrolling the space around the planetoid [[RZ7-6113-23]].

==Prelude==
Following the dissolution of the interim [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] amped up its efforts to patrol the farthest corners of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in an attempt to quell and potential uprisings or pockets of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] resistance. Many of these operations were commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who operated in the manner of "aggressive negotiations".<ref name="CE3.1" />

Concurrently, the Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Ennix Devian|Devian]] became wary of the remainder of the Empire, known as the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], under the influence of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]]. Amidst the possibility of an Imperial ceasefire with the New Republic, Devian and his followers seceded from the Remnant, feeling it strayed from the late [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] original vision. Devian and his followers took control of a storehouse on the [[Class-6 planetoid]] [[RZ7-6113-23]]. The storehouse was secretly commissioned in the early days of Palpatine's rule, and was stocked with [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]-era starships that officially ended production. Devian planned to build a military strong enough to topple both the New Republic and the Imperial Remnant. The so called "hardliners" of the Imperial Remnant dubbed themselves the "[[Restored Empire]]."<ref name="CE3.3" />

==The ambush==
{{Quote|Just what I was afraid of, I've led us right into a trap. Let's move before it's....''"<br />"''Too late, Captain, we've been fired upon!|Captain and Ensign of the ''Dauntless'' cruiser|<ref name="CE3.1" />}}
While patrolling the sector containing RZ7-6113-23, the crew of the [[Endor (Dauntless-class)|''Endor'']] intercepted two [[TIE/sr starfighter]]s. Because of their short-ranged nature, the scouts' presence in the area led the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the cruiser to suspect an Imperial base in the area, and as such he ordered the crew to follow the TIEs from a distance. The two scouts diverted from their path and began heading to the planetoid's surface, confirming the captain's suspicions. However, as the crew of the cruiser detected a large energy spike originating from a cannon in the vicinity of the ground base, the captain realized they were led into a trap, and ordered an immediate retreat. However, he was too late to realize the error of his judgment, and the cruiser was destroyed by a single blast from the fully charged cannon.<ref name="CE3.1" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I fear for the Republic, for your sister's family... they are in danger. You must warn them of a man named Devian.|Vima-Da-Boda|<ref name="CE3.1" />}}
In the wake of the ambush, word of Devian's plot reached [[Vima-Da-Boda]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[New Jedi Order]]. She promptly warned Skywalker of the massive plot brewing against the New Republic, and warned him to beware of a man named Devian.<ref name="CE3.1" />

Shortly after the ambush, the Restored Empire hired the renowned [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] to transport the former [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Imperial guardsmen]] [[Kir Kanos]] from the backwater [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Meenka]] to their base on RZ7.<ref name="CE3.1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ambush on the ''Dauntless'' cruiser was depicted in the opening scene of the [[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 1|first issue]] of [[Star Wars: Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost|''Star Wars: Crimson Empire III—Empire Lost'']], the third and final installment of the ''[[Star Wars: Crimson Empire]]'' trilogy.
